Name: (CP) Old School Clothes Sprites
Author: GongShim
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
THIS IS A AMATUER MOD! I always wanted to play Stardew with everyone in old-fashioned, historical clothes and couldn't find a mod for it, so I started editing the sprites on my own. I don't consider myself someone who can draw, I just really wanted historical sprites, so I decided to paint everyone into historical outfits on photoshop, just so my own playthrough would look the way I wanted. 

I'm sharing it here in case someone else likes the idea and I'm more than happy if anyone else wants to help! It can even be with ideas for winter clothes or halloween. I'm totally open, so if something looks off, tell me. 

So far I've done: Elliott, Haley, Harley, George and Evelyn. 
I do want to do all the villagers, so I will probably just update as I finish them.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure you have SAMPI and Content Patcher installed. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip this mod. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the folder inside your Mods [/color]directory.[/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game and enjoy![/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Historical, old-school outfits for the villagers (for now: Elliott, Haley, Harley, George and Evelyn) - no winter clothes available YET[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Beach versions included for the characters that have one [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Turn each character on or off in the config, so you can mix this with other sprite mods[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color]
